justification: Both surfaces carry incised/relief curvilinear elements, including hooked or crescent-like strokes and small round depressions, and both may contain a schematic living form, which is about as generic as shared content gets. A shows a densely packed, strictly vertical hierarchical composition with an elaborate frontal human figure in headdress and ornaments surrounded by dense ornamental panels, whereas B shows sparse, isolated linear strokes scattered over open rock with no discernible figure, frame or ordered register.
